- Next: trace all uses of those types across tests/ha/support/world and steps before editing.

- Next: verify no external callers depend on member_binding/local_dcs_service_for/runtime_configs, then remove the derived courier structs instead of merely flattening them.

- Next: patch the typed renderer, then run format/check/test.

- Fixed the two obvious post-refactor compile issues before validation: removed an incorrect Copy derive and removed a typed->string->typed round-trip with expect.
- Next: inspect Makefile targets, format touched code, run make check, then run a focused cargo nextest command for this area.
